text:
carl: heads-up: small night window for a blue->green egress stitch 00:30-01:00 UTC. plan: 8 steps, 12.5% every 3m, 2m keepalive checks after each. pin session-affinity to cookie_v2 for the window. @jin @sara please ack.
sara: ack. i'll watch p95/p99 across regions. confirm cookie write behavior?
jin: cookie_v2 reads are compatible; v2 will be set on writes. config: `session_affinity: cookie_v2`, ttl=1h. rollback policy: auto-pause if p95 > 250ms for 2m.
carl: rollout command (ops): `POST /admin/route/shift {"target":"v3","weight":12.5}`. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/egress-stitch (shortlink).
deploy-bot: triggered by carl at 2023-12-15T00:31:40Z. step1 -> 12.5% to v3.
ops-oncall: slight p95 blip in eu-west to ~230ms at 12.5%. no error spikes.
deploy-bot: step2 -> 25% to v3 (2023-12-15T00:34:50Z). probes green.
pradeep: hold — seeing redis miss rate climb on router-proxy for traffic to v3. correlation with v3 client open connections.
sara: i'll pause rollout. eu-west p95 now 340ms at 25%, tail is worse. recommend rollback unless pradeep can hotfix fast.
carl: pausing rollout at 25%. manual pause by pradeep.
deploy-bot: rollout paused at 25% (2023-12-15T00:37:12Z).
pradeep: quick root-cause: v3 default connection pool_shrink_threshold changed; under bursts it queues requests. pushing patch to restore previous pool defaults. ETA ~12m.
jin: can we shadow 1% of traffic to v3 with new pool config for validation?
sara: prefer rollback to 100% v2 for a clean baseline while fix is validated in staging.
carl: agreed. initiating rollback: drain v3 and reduce weight to 0% over 90s.
deploy-bot: rollback started by carl (2023-12-15T00:39:05Z). decreasing v3 weight -> 12.5% -> 0% over 90s.
ops-oncall: p95 returning to baseline within 60s of rollback. alerts calming.
deploy-bot: rollback complete (2023-12-15T00:40:30Z). traffic 100% v2. release-note draft: "egress stitch aborted 1/15: v3 connection pool defaults led to p95 regressions in eu-west; rolled back to v2."
carl: action items: (1) make pool defaults opt-in or match v2, (2) add `max_p95` guard to orchestrator so deploy-bot auto-pauses, (3) update runbook with immediate rollback criteria.
pradeep: will push hotfix to staging and run shadow traffic. opening follow-up thread with CI results.
jin: i'll add a probe job for 5% low-traffic window testing and add the `max_p95:250` check to shift job.
sara: i'll update change window notes and the release notes: "session-affinity pinned; watch eu-west p95 during rollout."
carl: thanks all. we'll reschedule a small probe after CI green. :thumbsup:
